**No game files are included.** You need your own copy of Islands of Wakfu (XBLA, title `584109AA`) and its title update 2.

## How to install

- **RecompLauncher**: add this game, point it to a folder holding the game package and the title update 2 package.
- **Manually**: extract the zip anywhere and run `WakfuRecomp.exe`, then give it the two packages.

The first start recompiles the game on your PC (a few minutes to an hour, ~1.5 GB of disk). Later starts are immediate.
Your settings and saves (`%APPDATA%\WakfuRecomp`) are kept across updates.

Windows SmartScreen or an antivirus may warn because the executable is not signed.
